description: Recursos Protección Civil is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Diputación Provincial de Málaga. Civil Protection Directory: groupings, contact and status of municipal and forestry emergency plans in the province of Malaga. Coverage: Diputación Provincial de Málaga. The portal shows the English title as "Civil Protection Resources" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Diputación Provincial de Málaga. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/licence/CC_BY_4_0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
